The '''Imperial Guard Academy''' was a training facility located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] that was used by the [[Imperial Guard]], the protectors of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A secret installation like the rest of the Guard's training centers, the Academy also served as a garrison of Imperial Guardsmen, who protected the nearby [[Temple of Sacrifice]] for the Emperor. During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Order of Revan]] sacked the Academy, damaging it and the surrounding grounds.
